page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines. The large capitals at the top and the smaller lines below are the printed title. Much of the page shows mirrored show-through from the reverse side, which is left out. A woodcut or engraved vignette stands in the centre of the page, with a line of imprint below it.
page.notes: The scan is very faint. The top capitals are legible only in part, and "BELGICARVM" and "REGVM" are read with [?] in places. The lines marked illegible are mostly mirrored show-through from the other side of the leaf, or too faint to read letter by letter. The engraving in the centre is described, not transcribed. The handwritten mark at the top left is not printed text and is left out. The lines of the imprint near the foot could not be read at all. Doubtful readings should be checked against a clearer copy.
